name: ehdl-ide
description: EHDL - ECAD using HDL. A VHDL-to-schematic IDE, as a native-embedded web app (Tauri + Vite + React).

scripts.gen:schematic: tsc src/vhdlPart.ts src/vhdlDesign.ts src/elaborate.ts --outDir .tmp-schematic --rootDir . --module commonjs --target es2020 --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck && tsc src/symbolFile.ts src/vhdlPart.ts --outDir .tmp-symbol --rootDir . --module commonjs --target es2020 --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck && node scripts/generate-schematic.mjs --lib examples/sample-project/sample_lib/components --top examples/sample-project/board.vhd --out src/generated
scripts.build: npm run gen:schematic && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:vhdl: tsc src/vhdlPart.ts scripts/vhdl-part-tests.ts --outDir .tmp-vhdl-tests --module commonjs --target es2020 --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck && node scripts/run-vhdl-tests.cjs
scripts.gen:footprint: tsc src/ipcFootprint.ts --outDir .tmp-footprint --rootDir . --module commonjs --target es2020 --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck && node scripts/generate-footprint.mjs
